messages:
Leah: Notifying CS channel — several customers hitting 502 on the final onboarding callback from our VPC bridge since 09:10 PT. This prevents tenant creation and blocks trial completion. I have a short list of affected tenants. Need coordinated outbound comm + temporary workaround offer.

incident-bot: [incident] 502 responses increased on /v1/tenants/callback between 09:11-09:18. Severity: P2. Bridge created: https://redwood.inc/bridges/17255

Tom: Oncall noticed a spike at 09:12 and marked infra. Hector, any clue?

Hector: We rolled a new env filter at 09:05 that tightened IP CIDR rules for the VPC connector. It looks like some customer source IPs were excluded unexpectedly. Quick fix: relax the CIDR for the callback path and restart the connector. I can do this in ~10m.

Leah: Can we offer a one-click manual provisioning so AEs can finish setup for impacted trials? If that takes longer, we should give an account credit and schedule a 1:1 enablement session.

Iris: Please prioritize acct-zen (closed-won trial) and acct-mercury (enterprise eval) — both are in active negotiation. I can call them immediately if we have a fix ETA.

Hector: Patch applied at 09:24 PT. Connector restarted. Watching for retries. Logs show callback 502 -> 200 for retried attempts.

Tom: Metrics: error rate down from 22% -> 4% in the 9:25-9:30 window. Still seeing a few lingering timeouts from one customer endpoint.

Leah: Draft outbound message for affected customers (short & empathetic):

"Hi — we experienced an internal routing restriction that briefly prevented the final step of onboarding. Weve applied a fix and your tenant provisioning should complete automatically within 10 minutes. If you remain blocked, reply here or schedule an immediate handoff: https://cal.redwood/example. Were offering an automatic one-month credit to any tenant that hit a provisioning failure. We value your patience — well follow up with a full RCA within 48 hours and a short feedback form: https://redwood.example/survey/onboard-failures"

Iris: Good. Add: "If youre on an urgent contract path, your AE will reach out directly." That calms renewals.

Hector: Internal action: adding an automated preflight check for CIDR changes on deploys that touch the VPC connector. Will share PR and rollout gating details.

Tom: CS ops tasks: generate affected tenant list (upload to #cs-files), mark tickets as P1 for high-touch, enable auto-crediting via billing flow for hits during 09:05-09:30 window, and schedule enablement hours.

Leah: I uploaded CSV to #cs-files: /files/affected_onboards_172550.csv. Includes tenant id, AE owner, onboarding step, and first failure time.

Iris: Called acct-zen at 09:40 PT; they were blocked but appreciated the proactive outreach. AE note: set expectation about RCA in 48 hours and offered a 15-min troubleshooting call.

Tom: Billing confirmed credits can be applied automatically. Will queue a batch job and notify AEs when completed.

Leah: Sending outbound comm now to the affected contact list. Pasting copy into each account thread and including the call link for high-touch.

Hector: Posting RCA draft in #eng-runtime in 30m with timeline, root cause (CIDR tighten), and the fix (rollback + better preflight gate). Also documenting the revert script.

Leah: Feedback capture plan: short one-question pulse + optional text box. Ill synthesize and flag any mention of churn risk. Links in comm and direct AEs to collect verbal feedback.

Iris: Two renewal-risk accounts flagged; Ill request tailored enablement and a personalized follow-up note.

Tom: Follow-up items for CS: 1) Confirm credits applied, 2) update account health dashboard with event flag, 3) schedule 2 office hours (one for UK-friendly times), 4) collect survey responses and escalate any negative signals.

Leah: All done: comms sent 09:46 PT, CSV uploaded, office hours scheduled (Wed 10am PT & Thu 4pm BST). Will post a short summary when Hector shares the RCA.

Hector: RCA posted in #eng-runtime at 10:12 PT. Root cause: CIDR rule tightening in prod deploy; preventive measure: deploy gating + automated integration test to simulate callback from representative customer IPs.

Tom: Closing incident in 24h if metrics remain stable. Alarms lowered thresholds for 72h and preflight rule added.

Leah: Thanks team. CS will follow up with customers tomorrow with the formal RCA and confirmation of credits applied. If any AEs need help drafting personalized notes, ping me here. :white_check_mark:
